ko: 팀원들과 일정을 조율한 뒤에 회의 시간을 확정했어요.
de: Nachdem ich den Zeitplan mit dem Team abgestimmt hatte, habe ich den Besprechungstermin festgelegt.
en: After coordinating the schedule with the team, I confirmed the meeting time.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0260; vocabKo=조율하다; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=자료를|공유했어요; context=team schedule coordination; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 회의 참석 여부를 오늘 안에 알려 주세요.
de: Bitte teilen Sie uns noch heute mit, ob Sie an der Besprechung teilnehmen können.
en: Please let us know by today whether you can attend the meeting.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0261; vocabKo=참석 여부; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=연락을|기다려; context=same-day attendance confirmation; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 마감일이 가까운 업무의 우선순위를 먼저 정했어요.
de: Wir haben zuerst die Prioritäten für die Aufgaben mit naher Abgabefrist festgelegt.
en: We first set the priorities for tasks with approaching deadlines.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0262; vocabKo=우선순위; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=회의실을|예약했어요; context=prioritizing deadline-sensitive tasks; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 오후 회의를 위해 3층 회의실을 예약했어요.
de: Für die Besprechung am Nachmittag habe ich einen Raum im dritten Stock reserviert.
en: I reserved a meeting room on the third floor for the afternoon meeting.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0263; vocabKo=회의실; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=참석자를|변경했어요; context=reserve an afternoon meeting room; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 담당자가 부재중이라 제가 그분을 대체해 업무를 맡기로 했어요.
de: Da die zuständige Person nicht da war, habe ich zugesagt, sie zu vertreten.
en: Since the person in charge was unavailable, I agreed to take over their duties.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0264; vocabKo=대체하다; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=연락드릴|예정이에요; context=cover for unavailable person; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 자료가 늦게 도착해서 회의 시작이 20분 지연됐어요.
de: Weil die Unterlagen spät ankamen, hat sich der Beginn der Besprechung um zwanzig Minuten verzögert.
en: Because the materials arrived late, the start of the meeting was delayed by 20 minutes.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0265; vocabKo=지연되다; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=일정을|확정할게요; context=meeting start delayed by late materials; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 회의 전에 업무 분담을 정해서 각자 맡을 일을 확인했어요.
de: Vor der Besprechung haben wir die Aufgabenverteilung festgelegt und geprüft, wer was übernimmt.
en: Before the meeting we agreed on the division of tasks and confirmed what each person would handle.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0266; vocabKo=업무 분담; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=회의실을|예약했어요; context=division of tasks before meeting; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 이 보고서의 마감일은 다음 주 금요일이에요.
de: Die Abgabefrist für diesen Bericht ist nächsten Freitag.
en: The deadline for this report is next Friday.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0267; vocabKo=마감일; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=참석자는|오늘; context=report deadline date; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 결정이 늦어져서 회의를 다음 주로 미뤘어요.
de: Da sich die Entscheidung verzögerte, haben wir die Besprechung auf nächste Woche verschoben.
en: Because the decision was delayed, we postponed the meeting until next week.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0268; vocabKo=미루다; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=시간을|확정했어요; context=meeting moved after delayed decision; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 참석 인원을 확인한 뒤에 최종 일정을 확정할게요.
de: Nachdem ich die Zahl der Teilnehmenden geprüft habe, werde ich den endgültigen Termin festlegen.
en: After checking the number of participants, I will finalize the schedule.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0269; vocabKo=확정하다; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=마감일을|미뤘어요; context=final schedule after attendance check; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 팀장님이 부재중이셔서 메일로 보고드렸어요.
de: Da die Teamleitung abwesend war, habe ich per E-Mail Bericht erstattet.
en: Since the team leader was unavailable, I sent a report by email.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0270; vocabKo=부재중; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=회의록을|보냈어요; context=leave report for absent team leader; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 일정 변경에 협조해 주셔서 감사합니다.
de: Vielen Dank, dass Sie bei der Terminänderung mitgewirkt haben.
en: Thank you for cooperating with the schedule change.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0271; vocabKo=협조하다; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=확인해|주시면; context=thank counterpart for schedule cooperation; target uses complete B1 sentence

ko: 접수된 민원에 대해 담당 부서가 검토를 시작했습니다.
de: Die zuständige Abteilung hat mit der Prüfung der eingereichten Beschwerde begonnen.
en: The responsible department has begun reviewing the complaint that was filed.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0217; vocabKo=민원; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=서면으로|답변드리겠습니다; context=formal complaint review begins; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 제품의 결함이 확인되면 즉시 교환 절차를 안내해 드리겠습니다.
de: Wenn ein Produktmangel bestätigt wird, informieren wir Sie unverzüglich über das Umtauschverfahren.
en: If a product defect is confirmed, we will promptly explain the exchange procedure.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0218; vocabKo=결함; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=보상을|검토하겠습니다; context=confirmed defect and exchange procedure; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 불편을 드린 점에 대해 적절한 보상 방안을 검토하겠습니다.
de: Wir werden angemessene Möglichkeiten der Entschädigung für die entstandenen Unannehmlichkeiten prüfen.
en: We will review appropriate compensation options for the inconvenience caused.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0219; vocabKo=보상; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=결함을|처리하겠습니다; context=review compensation response; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 같은 문제가 반복되지 않도록 절차상의 문제를 시정하겠습니다.
de: Wir werden die Probleme im Verfahren beheben, damit sich dasselbe Problem nicht wiederholt.
en: We will correct the procedural issues so that the same problem does not recur.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0220; vocabKo=시정하다; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=서면|답변드리겠습니다; context=correct procedure to prevent recurrence; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 재발을 막기 위해 원인을 분석하고 개선안을 마련했습니다.
de: Um ein erneutes Auftreten zu verhindern, haben wir die Ursache analysiert und Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ausgearbeitet.
en: To prevent recurrence, we analyzed the cause and prepared improvement measures.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0221; vocabKo=재발; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=결함을|확인했습니다; context=cause analysis and improvement plan; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 제출하신 이의 제기는 어제 공식적으로 접수했습니다.
de: Wir haben Ihren eingereichten Einspruch gestern offiziell entgegengenommen.
en: We officially received your submitted objection yesterday.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0222; vocabKo=접수하다; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=서면|답변을; context=official receipt of appeal; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 담당 부서에서 관련 서류를 검토한 뒤 민원을 처리할 예정입니다.
de: Die zuständige Abteilung wird die Beschwerde bearbeiten, nachdem sie die relevanten Unterlagen geprüft hat.
en: The responsible department will process the complaint after reviewing the relevant documents.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0223; vocabKo=처리하다; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=보상을|제공할; context=department processes complaint after review; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 담당 부서에서 확인한 뒤 서면으로 답변드리겠습니다.
de: Nach Prüfung durch die zuständige Abteilung werden wir Ihnen schriftlich antworten.
en: After the responsible department has reviewed the matter, we will respond to you in writing.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0224; vocabKo=담당 부서; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=민원을|처리하겠습니다; context=responsible department provides written response; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 결과에 대한 이의 제기는 안내된 기한 안에 제출해 주시기 바랍니다.
de: Bitte reichen Sie einen Einspruch gegen das Ergebnis innerhalb der angegebenen Frist ein.
en: Please submit any objection to the result within the stated deadline.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0225; vocabKo=이의 제기; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=보상을|요청해; context=appeal is submitted within deadline; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 검토가 끝나는 대로 서면 답변을 보내드리겠습니다.
de: Sobald die Prüfung abgeschlossen ist, senden wir Ihnen eine schriftliche Antwort.
en: As soon as the review is complete, we will send you a written response.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0226; vocabKo=서면 답변; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=결함을|시정하겠습니다; context=written answer follows review; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 확인된 결함에 대해 필요한 조치를 이미 취했습니다.
de: Wir haben bereits die notwendigen Maßnahmen hinsichtlich des bestätigten Mangels ergriffen.
en: We have already taken the necessary action regarding the confirmed defect.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0227; vocabKo=조치; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=서면|답변을; context=completed corrective action; target uses complete B2 sentence

ko: 누락된 내용을 보완한 뒤 다시 제출해 주시기 바랍니다.
de: Bitte ergänzen Sie die fehlenden Angaben und reichen Sie die Unterlagen anschließend erneut ein.
en: Please supplement the missing information and then submit the documents again.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0228; vocabKo=보완하다; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; distractorTiles=민원을|처리해; context=complete missing information before resubmission; target uses complete B2 sentence
